subject: OTLP adapter packaging & field readiness for Grafana Cloud / Datadog
messages:
From: Avery Jones <avery@grafana.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OTLP adapter packaging & field readiness for Grafana Cloud / Datadog

Hi team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, Grafana Cloud wants a packaged OTLP adapter that can be listed in our integrations marketplace and that Datadog can optionally ingest via an aligned mapping. The two asks from our side to make this field-ready are: 

1) A short QA matrix (smoke tests + failure cases) that we can run in our sandbox.
2) A marketplace-ready one-pager for co-sell / field enablement (screenshots + installation path + supported sitelens).

I've attached a draft adapter-spec-v1.pdf that sketches the expected config (ports, TLS knob, authentication modes) and an example OTLP mapping. Marco from Datadog is looped in to confirm the mapping details.

Can you confirm target packaging (Docker container + Helm chart) and whether Redwood can commit to the smoke-tests within two weeks? If not, propose alternate ETA.

Cheers,
Avery

Attachment: adapter-spec-v1.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Avery Jones <avery@grafana.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OTLP adapter packaging & field readiness for Grafana Cloud / Datadog

Avery — thanks for the clear spec. Quick notes from our side: 

- Packaging: agree on Docker + Helm; we'll supply a ChartMuseum-ready helm chart and a container image in our registry.
- QA matrix: we'll run the smoke suite (connectivity, TLS rotation, basic metric/event/span pass-through, sampling behavior) and share otlp-smoke-report.csv.
- Mapping: Marco — can you confirm whether Datadog expects any extra attribute renaming (e.g., service.name -> dd.service) or if the plain OTLP attributes are fine?

Proposed timeline:
- Thu 11/19: internal build and preliminary smoke run (dev infra).
- Tue 11/24: hand over smoke report + packaging artifacts to Grafana for sandbox validation.
- Thu 12/03: field enablement one-pager ready for co-sell review.

Ben — can you own the marketplace one-pager + the co-sell positioning? Laura — can you confirm any legal/marketplace listing constraints (third-party requirements) we need to include in the one-pager?

Thanks — I'll attach the initial smoke CSV after the run.

— Soojin
Infrastructure Partnerships, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Avery Jones <avery@grafana.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OTLP adapter packaging & field readiness for Grafana Cloud / Datadog

Soojin / Avery / Laura — happy to take the one-pager. A few quick asks for alignment with field: 

- Target buyer persona: platform engineers at mid-market / enterprise with self-hosted Grafana + hybrid Datadog ingestion. I'll draft two callouts (self-hosted vs hosted).
- SKU / billing note: does Grafana want the listing to reference a Redwood-managed SaaS offering or just host the integration and link to our docs? If the former we'll need a short paragraph on billing flow for the marketplace.

I'll circulate a first draft by Mon 11/23. Attaching a working version of the one-pager as co-sell-onepager.pdf (stub).

— Ben
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: co-sell-onepager.pdf (PDF stub)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Avery Jones <avery@grafana.com>, Marco Santoro <marco@datadog.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OTLP adapter packaging & field readiness for Grafana Cloud / Datadog

Thanks team — good momentum. Quick summary and action items (so it's crystal):

- Soojin: run full smoke suite and share otlp-smoke-report.csv by 11/24. Add a short note about supported auth modes (mTLS, token).
- Ben: one-pager draft by 11/23; include both install flows and a short "who pays" appendix (marketplace vs direct).
- Marco: please confirm attribute mapping and whether Datadog requires any ingestion tag to be present for metrics.
- Avery: Grafana to validate packaged chart in their sandbox 11/25–11/26.

I'll loop in Legal if we need to include specific marketplace terms; otherwise, Ben and I will sign off on co-sell collateral. If anyone anticipates a blocker on the timeline, flag it today.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
